name: Bombardier Global series
summary: Bombardier's large-cabin, ultra-long-range jets; a few serve the USAF as the E-11A communications relay aircraft.

wings: Low wing with strong sweep and blended upturned winglets
engines: Two Rolls-Royce BR710 or Pearl turbofans in long nacelles mounted well aft on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Very long, slim fuselage with many rounded-rectangle windows
tail: Tall T-tail with a swept fin

tellTales: Very long, slim fuselage with a row of rounded-rectangle windows
Tall T-tail with engines set far back near the tail
Strongly swept wing with blended winglets

confusedWith.howToTell: The Global has rounded-rectangle windows; the G650/G700 has large oval windows.
The Global has rounded-rectangle windows and a longer fuselage; the GIV/G550 has oval windows.
The Global is much longer and slimmer; the Challenger 600-series is short and fat.
